name: git-status
summary: branch, ahead/behind and changed files in two-letter short form

name: git-diff
summary: unstaged diff: stat block then patch with 2 context lines, no colour or pager

name: git-log
summary: last 20 commits, one line each with short date and refs

name: pytest-quick
summary: pytest, quiet, stop at first failure, short tracebacks, no .pytest_cache

name: lines
summary: print lines start..end of a file with line numbers, stops reading at end

name: outline
summary: classes, functions and exports with line numbers (Python, JS, TS) instead of reading the whole file

name: git-staged
summary: staged diff (what a commit would contain): stat then patch

name: git-show
summary: one commit: header, stat and patch with 2 context lines

name: files
summary: file paths matching a regex, tracked plus untracked, honouring .gitignore (fd stand-in)

name: gh-pr
summary: pull request facts as JSON: state, branches, review decision, size, body

name: gh-checks
summary: CI checks on a PR: pass/fail/pending bucket, name, link (exit 8 while pending)

name: gh-run-failed
summary: log of only the failed steps, last 150 lines; defaults to the newest failed run
body: f(){ id=${1:-$(gh run list --status failure --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId')}; [ -n "$id" ] || { echo 'no failed runs'; return 0; }; echo "run $id"; gh run view "$id" --log-failed | tail -n 150; }; f

name: gh-pr-comments
summary: inline review comments on a PR as path:line author: text

name: git-changed
summary: files this branch changed against a base (default origin/main), with A/M/D status

name: http-json
summary: GET a URL as JSON, follow redirects, then print HTTP status and time

name: npm-scripts
summary: the scripts block of package.json in this folder

name: npm-run
summary: run a package.json script without npm's banner lines

name: tsc-check
summary: TypeScript type check with the project's own tsc, no emit, one error per line; never installs

name: uv-run
summary: run a command in the project's synced uv environment without progress noise

name: uv-with
summary: run a Python one-liner with a package available, no install into any project

name: tex-build
summary: build a LaTeX file to PDF next to it with tectonic, keeping the .log for errors

name: tex-problems
summary: build, then list LaTeX errors, undefined refs/citations and overfull boxes from the log
body: f(){ tectonic -X compile --keep-logs "$1" 2>&1 | grep -E '^error:'; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; grep -nE '^!|undefined|Overfull|multiply defined' "${1%.tex}.log" | head -40; echo "tectonic exit $rc"; return $rc; }; f

name: pytest-list
summary: list test ids without running them

name: pytest-lf
summary: rerun only the tests that failed last time (writes .pytest_cache)

name: gh-prs
summary: open pull requests, one tab-separated line each
body: gh pr list --limit 20 --json number,headRefName,author,isDraft,reviewDecision,title --jq '.[] | "#\(.number)\t\(.headRefName)\t\(.author.login)\t\(if .isDraft then "draft" else (.reviewDecision // "-") end)\t\(.title)"'

name: gh-issue
summary: one issue as JSON with labels, body and comments

name: gh-issues
summary: open issues, one tab-separated line each with labels

name: gh-runs
summary: last 10 Actions runs: id, conclusion, workflow, branch

name: gh-pr-files
summary: names of the files a PR changes

name: diff-files
summary: unified diff of any two files (not in a repo), exit 1 when they differ

name: git-blame
summary: who changed lines start..end, ignoring whitespace, short dates

name: git-file-log
summary: history of one file across renames, one line per commit

name: git-branches
summary: local branches newest first with upstream ahead/behind and last subject

name: git-hot
summary: files touched most in the last N commits (default 50)
body: f(){ git log -n "${1:-50}" --name-only --pretty=format: | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -25; }; f

name: todos
summary: TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX and ponytail: markers in tracked text files

name: loc-top
summary: the 25 largest tracked files by line count
body: git ls-files -z | xargs -0 wc -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v ' total$' | sort -rn | head -25

name: ruff-check
summary: ruff lint, one line per problem, without installing ruff into the project

name: media-probe
summary: duration, size, codecs, resolution, fps and audio channels of a media file as JSON

name: video-sheet
summary: contact sheet: one frame every 10 s, 4x4 grid, to see a whole video in one image

name: video-frame
summary: save one frame at a timestamp (e.g. 00:01:30) as an image

name: docker-ps
summary: all containers: name, image, status, ports

name: compose-ps
summary: compose services in this folder: service, state, ports

name: compose-logs
summary: last 100 log lines per compose service with timestamps, no colour

name: port
summary: which process id is listening on a local port (Windows netstat)
body: f(){ netstat -ano | grep LISTENING | grep -E ":$1[[:space:]]"; }; f

name: npm-info
summary: registry facts for a package: latest version, licence, repo, last publish
body: npm view --json {1} name version license repository.url homepage time.modified

name: gh-search-repos
summary: top 10 GitHub repos for a query by stars, with licence and last push

name: http-post-json
summary: POST a JSON body, print the response and HTTP status

name: pw-test
summary: Playwright tests with the one-line-per-test reporter, never installs

name: archive-ls
summary: list the files inside a .zip, .tar, .tar.gz or .tgz
body: f(){ case "$1" in *.zip) unzip -Z1 "$1";; *) tar -tf "$1";; esac; }; f
